notes.title: Early Access PC and VR Gameplay Videos Now Added
notes.notes: Ahoy mateys!  We've added a video for you to see what gameplay looks like! We shot a PC and VR version! Welcome to the Cursed Isles!  This is Early Access so keep that in mind!  Enjoy!

notes.title: Avast ye mateys! Cursed Isles is now live!
notes.notes: Cursed Isles is awaiting your entry!  This game is early access!  If you have wishlisted us, now is the time to come in the game and check out our early beginnings!  If you have not wishlisted us, no problem!  The game is waiting for you to explore!  Please know that we are looking forward to making updates in the near future!  As a reminder, this is both a PC and VR game.  Check out the tavern, kill some enemies and navigate your very own ship!
